ruleApplications.detail: Unambiguous group-local source cycles remain source-bound.
13-16 January exam period remains service metadata only; no synthetic events.
Shared Management block on 12 January remains four timed events.
For each ENT cycle, the final source date is 09:00-12:55; preceding dates are 09:00-12:05.
PE recurs on Fridays; 18.12 and 25.12 replace base time with 16:10-17:40; PE is omitted on four confirmed ophthalmology-conflict dates.
Shared Practice 18-30 January is retained as source-date all-day/date-only events.
